newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates drop to end at 20.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates drop to end at 20.25 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates finished half a percentage point lower on Tuesday in abundant liquidity, traders said.
Overnight rates closed at 20.25 percent compared with Monday's close of 20.50/75 percent.
"It seems that large amounts are flowing back from the central bank's reverse repo facility," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.

He added that in the absence of market-moving factors, overnight rates could ease further in the next few days, unless major players decide to put their money back into the one-week or one-month reverse repo facilities.
"This will become clear in the afternoon from the direction tom/next rates are taking," Tolonics said.
